subject: [PATCH v2 09/11] nfsd: grant a plain read delegation when timestamps are wanted on a read open

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFS server to grant a plain read delegation when a client requests delegated timestamps on a read open operation. This is done by changing the delegation type from OPEN_DELEGATE_READ_ATTRS_DELEG to OPEN_DELEGATE_READ, as delegating atime correctly would require exclusive authority or merging of multiple clients' times, which NFSD does not support. The patch addresses an issue introduced in a previous commit that added support for delegated timestamps and ensures compliance with RFC 9754 section 5. The changes affect the nfsd module's handling of read open operations and delegation types.
